===== Components/ButtonView.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component (best effort; see the notes).
import SwiftUI

struct ButtonView: View {
  enum Size: String, CaseIterable {
    case sm, md, lg
  }
  enum State: String, CaseIterable {
    case `default`, hover, disabled
  }
  var size: Size = .md
  var state: State = .`default`
  var label: String = "Button"
  var icon: AnyView = AnyView(IconCheckView())
  var showIcon: Bool = false
  var content: AnyView = AnyView(EmptyView())

  var body: some View {
    switch (size, state) {
    case (.lg, .`default`):
      Color.clear
        .padding(EdgeInsets(top: 12, leading: 24, bottom: 12, trailing: 24))
        .background(Color.colorBrand)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
    default:
      HStack(spacing: 8) {
        Spacer(minLength: 0)
        if showIcon {
          IconCheckView()
        }
        Text(label)
          .font(.custom("Inter", size: 14))
          .fontWeight(.semibold)
          .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1))
          .lineSpacing(4.2)
          .fixedSize()
        Spacer(minLength: 0)
      }
        .padding(EdgeInsets(top: 8, leading: 16, bottom: 8, trailing: 16))
        .background(Color.colorBrand)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
    }
  }
}

#Preview {
  ButtonView()
}
===== Components/IconCheckView.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component (best effort; see the notes).
import SwiftUI

struct IconCheckView: View {

  var body: some View {
    ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
      Image("path")
        .resizable()
        .frame(width: 16, height: 16)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
      .frame(width: 16, height: 16)
  }
}

#Preview {
  IconCheckView()

===== Screens/CheckoutView.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design (best effort; see the notes).
import SwiftUI

struct CheckoutView: View {
  var body: some View {
    // Not mapped: scrolling (wrap the view in a ScrollView)
    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: .space4) {
      (Text("Total ") + Text("$42.00").fontWeight(.bold))
        .font(.custom("Inter", size: 16))
        .foregroundStyle(Color.colorText)
        .lineSpacing(4.8)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
      // Not mapped: grid placement
      Grid(horizontalSpacing: 8, verticalSpacing: 8) {
        GridRow {
          Image("bag")
            .resizable()
            .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fill)
            .frame(width: 320, height: 180)
            .accessibilityLabel("A shopping bag")
        }
      }
        .padding(16)
        .frame(minWidth: 240, maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        .background(LinearGradient(stops: [.init(color: Color(red: 0.388, green: 0.4, blue: 0.945), location: 0), .init(color: Color(red: 0.659, green: 0.333, blue: 0.969), location: 1)], startPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.146, y: 0.146), endPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.854, y: 0.854)))
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12).strokeBorder(Color(red: 0.894, green: 0.894, blue: 0.906), lineWidth: 1))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        .shadow(color: Color.shadowColor, radius: 8, x: 0, y: 4)
        .accessibilityLabel("Product card")
      Color.clear
        .padding(EdgeInsets(top: 12, leading: 24, bottom: 12, trailing: 24))
        .background(Color.colorBrand)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
      Spacer(minLength: 0)
    }
      .padding(24)
      .frame(width: 390, height: 844)
      .background(Color.colorBgSurface)
      .clipped()
  }
}

#Preview {
  CheckoutView()
}

import SwiftUI

struct DoneView: View {

        .resizable()

        .offset(x: 183, y: 410)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
      .frame(width: 390, height: 844)
      .background(Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1))
      .clipped()

===== Tokens.swift
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's variables. Do not edit by hand.
import SwiftUI

extension Color {
  /// A color with a light and a dark value (follows the system appearance).
  init(light: Color, dark: Color) {
    #if canImport(UIKit)
    self.init(uiColor: UIColor { $0.userInterfaceStyle == .dark ? UIColor(dark) : UIColor(light) })
    #else
    self = light
    #endif
  }

  static let colorBgSurface = Color(light: Color(red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1), dark: Color(red: 0.094, green: 0.094, blue: 0.106))
  static let colorBrand = Color(light: Color(red: 0.31, green: 0.275, blue: 0.898), dark: Color(red: 0.506, green: 0.549, blue: 0.973))
  static let colorBrandBright = Color(light: Color(red: 0.506, green: 0.549, blue: 0.973), dark: Color(red: 0.506, green: 0.549, blue: 0.973))
  static let colorText = Color(light: Color(red: 0.094, green: 0.094, blue: 0.106), dark: Color(red: 0.98, green: 0.98, blue: 0.98))
  static let shadowColor = Color(light: Color(red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0, opacity: 0.122), dark: Color(red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0, opacity: 0.4))
}

extension CGFloat {
  static let space4: CGFloat = 16
}
